_comment: GRF knob sweep — the consolidated replacement for the retired pantheon_knob_sweep.py. Exercises node_mass_amplitude x node_mass_seed with init_distribution fixed to 'grf' over the user M/S grid. amplitude=0 collapses to a single nm_seed=42 cell (handled by expand_grid). S is co-fit per M (use 'S_values': an explicit list to pin the old fixed S grid instead). sweep.py writes the full ws1_sweep_knob_grf.csv (the knob-summary superset) plus the best-isotropic sweep_results_pantheon_knob_grf.csv (load_best_config-compatible).
